title: XIAO ESP32S3 + Wio-SX1262 illustrated assembly
scope: Four physical assembly steps. Firmware flashing and radio configuration are outside this sheet.
method: Official STEP board geometry, supplemented with reconstructed kit parts and antenna geometry from manufacturer drawings and physical photos. Fixed geometry reused across steps.
supplemental_geometry: Two already installed seven-pin XIAO headers
Coax cables and low-profile crimped plugs
limitations: Illustrations are for assembly, not enclosure machining or dimensional inspection.
Antenna bends and exploded gap are arranged for readability.
Supplemental connector, button and header shapes are simplified.
Wi-Fi A-02 antenna reference is not proof of exact dimensions of every kit revision.
